blocks.text: At a cafe in Tokyo’s famed Akihabara district, “maids” are increasingly learning to accommodate foreign visitors by studying English phrases and handing out specialized gifts. Known as a mecca for Japan’s “otaku” subculture, Akihabara is packed with goods related to popular anime, manga and video game series and is also believed to be the birthplace of maid cafes. The cafes are a Japanese phenomenon where predominantly female staff dress in maid costumes and act as servers and entertainers for their customers.
